description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting our commitment to attracting top talent. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate leader with a strong background in long-term care, passionate about delivering exceptional patient outcomes and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and maintaining compliance with all state and federal regulations. You will play a crucial role in staff development, quality improvement initiatives, and creating a positive and efficient clinical environment. This is an excellent opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents and the success of our facility.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
Demonstrated leadership, management, and communication skills
